exclusions.source_text: Male and female participants at least 12 years of age (at least 18 years of age for Cohort B1)
History of a second malignancy, unless potentially curative treatment has been completed with no evidence of malignancy for 2 years
exclusions.threshold: no evidence of malignancy for 2 years

exclusions.source_text: Clinically significant cardiac disease, including unstable angina, acute myocardial infarction, or arterial bypass (CABG) or Percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA) ≤6 months from study entry, or New York Heart Association Class III or IV congestive heart failure
exclusions.threshold: CABG/PTCA ≤6 months; NYHA Class III or IV
